title: Maximum Containers on a Ship
summary: Given an n x n cargo deck where each cell can hold one container with a weight of exactly w, determine the maximum number of containers that can be loaded onto the ship without exceeding its maximum weight capacity, maxWeight.
statement: Given an n x n cargo deck where each cell can hold one container with a weight of exactly w, determine the maximum number of containers that can be loaded onto the ship without exceeding its maximum weight capacity, maxWeight.
constraints: An n by n deck has n squared container positions.
Every container weighs exactly w and total weight cannot exceed maxWeight.
Return the greatest number of containers that fit both limits.
hints: Deck area limits the count to n squared.
Integer division maxWeight//w gives the weight-limited count.
The smaller of the two independent capacities is achievable and maximal.
editorial: The smaller of the two independent capacities is achievable and maximal.

tests.explanation: The deck has four cells and the weight limit permits five containers, so four fit.
Weight permits only two containers despite nine deck cells.
